basic_details.short_information: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC), Metropolitan Surveillance Unit (MSU) Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 28 August 2026 on the official website of Pune Municipal Corporation. A total of 8 vacancies have been announced through the PMC Recruitment 2026 for Senior Public Health Specialist, Microbiologist, Veterinary Officer, Technical Assistant, Entomologist, Technical Officer (IT) and Data Analyst posts on a contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: PMC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC), Metropolitan Surveillance Unit (MSU) has officially released the recruitment notification dated 28 August 2026 for engagement of candidates for Senior Public Health Specialist, Microbiologist, Veterinary Officer, Technical Assistant, Entomologist, Technical Officer (IT) and Data Analyst posts. The notification includes complete details on post-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, experience requirements, age limits, monthly remuneration, application process, required documents, selection process and important terms and conditions of contractual engagement is available on the official PMC website. Download PMC Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Official Website

content_sections.heading: PMC Vacancy 2026: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 8 vacancies are available - 1 for Senior Public Health Specialist, 1 for Microbiologist, 1 for Veterinary Officer, 1 for Technical Assistant, 1 for Entomologist, 2 for Technical Officer (IT), and 1 for Data Analyst. All posts are contractual, for a duration of 11 months and 29 days. The number of posts is subject to change at the discretion of the Pune Mahanagarpalika administration.

content_sections.heading: PMC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Forms and self-attested documents must be submitted during office hours (excluding government holidays) at the Health Department office in Shivaji Nagar, Pune.

rows.event: Last Date for Submission of Form and Documents

content_sections.heading: PMC Eligibility Criteria and Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet either of the following three qualification routes: MBBS (recognized by MCI) with MD in PSM/Community Medicine, MD (CHA), or MD (Tropical Medicine), or DNB in Social and Preventive Medicine/Community Medicine. MBBS (recognized by MCI) with an EIS (Epidemic Intelligence Service) Training Course Certificate. BDS/BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BPT/B.Sc. in Life Sciences (Nursing, Biology, Microbiology, Developmental Biology and Physiology) with an MPH (Epidemiology) or DPH (Epidemiology); OR a Master in Applied Epidemiology (MAE) plus two years of Public Health experience; OR a PhD in Clinical Sciences, Medical Science, Preventive Medicine, Human Physiology, Pathophysiology or Epidemiology. Experience required: At least 10 years of field experience, after obtaining the essential qualification, in implementing public health programmes or interventions with a focus on communicable diseases. The candidate must have passed a 100-mark Marathi language paper in SSC and HSC, and must have working command over the Marathi language. Candidates must meet either of the following: MBBS with MD/DNB in Medical Microbiology or Lab Medicine, recognized by MCI/DNB. M.Sc. in Medical Microbiology/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Biomedical Sciences with a PhD in the same or related field. Experience required: At least 3 years of experience in a clinical microbiology laboratory or public health programme, after obtaining the postgraduate degree/PhD. A postgraduate veterinary degree in any one of: Veterinary Public Health, Veterinary Epidemiology, Veterinary Medicine, Veterinary Microbiology, Veterinary Preventive Medicine, or Veterinary Pathology, along with registration in the Veterinary Council of India or a State Veterinary Council. Experience required: At least 1 year of post-qualification experience in Veterinary Public Health, Veterinary Epidemiology, or Animal Health, along with relevant experience in public health, preferably in disease surveillance and outbreak investigations. B.Sc. in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT) from a recognized university, or B.Sc. in Chemistry/Botany/Zoology/Biotechnology with a DMLT or BMLT. Candidates must hold registration/renewal with the Maharashtra Paramedical Council. Experience required (essential): At least 2 years of experience in a clinical microbiology laboratory, and proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Desirable: work experience in a bacteriology laboratory. M.Sc. in Entomology or Zoology, preferably with a Doctorate (PhD) in Medical Entomology. Experience required: At least 5 years in entomological investigations related to zoonotic diseases of public health importance during outbreaks, including zoonotic disease surveillance and plague surveillance in India. Candidates must meet either of the following: A postgraduate degree in IT/Computer Science such as M.Tech, MBA (IT), MCA, or M.Sc. (CS/IT). A graduate degree in IT/Computer Science such as B.E., B.Tech, BIT, or BCA. Experience required: At least 2 years

content_sections.heading: PMC Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not describe a written examination. Based on the terms and conditions, the process works as follows: Applications submitted with self-attested documents are scrutinized by the Health Department. Eligible and ineligible candidates are notified from time to time on the PMC website (https://www.pmc.gov.in). A merit list is prepared according to the number of applications received, and selection is made on the basis of qualification and experience; preference is given to candidates with more experience and higher educational qualification, though the final decision rests with the administration. The decision of the selection committee is final, and the final merit list remains valid for 1 year. Selected candidates are required to execute an agreement on a Rs. 500 bond paper.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: https://www.pmc.gov.in Download the prescribed application form for the relevant post. Fill in the form completely and attach self-attested copies of all required documents (passport-size photo, birth date proof, photo ID/residence proof, educational qualification certificates, MMC/council registration certificates, experience certificates, caste certificate where applicable, etc.). Submit the filled form and documents in person at: 3rd Floor, Main Building, Shivaji Nagar, Arogya Vibhag, Pune Mahanagarpalika, between 28 August 2026 and 15 September 2026, during office hours (excluding government holidays). For queries, contact the Health Department on 020-25502114. Note: This is not an online-submission process. Candidates download the form online but must submit it, along with hard copies of documents, physically at the office.

content_sections.heading: Key Terms and Conditions PMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: These are contract posts and carry no relationship with the regular establishment of Pune Mahanagarpalika; as per the Maharashtra Government's General Administration Department resolution dated 25 August 2005, no contractual employee can claim permanency regardless of years served. The total number of posts advertised is subject to change. Each post is for a period of 11 months and 29 days; positions automatically lapse when the relevant project/scheme ends. Experience gained in government, semi-government, local self-government bodies, or private organizations will be considered. Any candidate found using political or other pressure during selection will be disqualified. The Additional Municipal Commissioner, Pune Mahanagarpalika, reserves the right to change or cancel the selection process at any stage without assigning reasons. Selected candidates are bound to work only within the Metropolitan Surveillance Unit office; seeking a transfer to another department through undue means will lead to cancellation of selection. Candidates cannot request a change of posting location during the contract period for convenience. Submission of false information or documents will lead to disqualification at any stage, including after appointment, and services may be terminated without prior notice. Documents submitted after the prescribed deadline will not be considered, and the application will be treated as ineligible. Pune Mahanagarpalika has not authorized any individual or agency to sell or accept application forms on its behalf; candidates are advised to be cautious of intermediaries promising jobs. The Additional Municipal Commissioner, Pune Mahanagarpalika, reserves full rights to modify the required experience, age limit, or educational qualification for the advertised posts. This is a summary of the key conditions. Candidates should read the complete terms and conditions in the official notification before applying. Candidates with qualifications such as MBBS, MD, DNB, M.Sc., B.Sc., B.E., B.Tech, MCA, BCA, postgraduate degrees and other relevant qualifications can also explore more Medical Government Jobs, Public Health Jobs, Technical Jobs and Government Jobs available across India. Candidates looking for opportunities in Maharashtra can also explore the latest Maharashtra Government Jobs and Pune Government Jobs . Those interested in healthcare, public health, IT and data analysis careers can check more Health Department Jobs, Medical Jobs, IT Jobs, Data Analyst Jobs and PMC Recruitment opportunities matching their qualifications.

faq.question: Q1. What is PMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contract recruitment drive by Pune Mahanagarpalika's Health Department (Arogya Vibhag) and Communicable Disease Control Department (Sathrog Niyantran Vibhag) to fill 8 posts across 7 categories under the Metropolitan Surveillance Unit (MSU).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in PMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies across 7 post categories: Senior Public Health Specialist (1), Microbiologist (1), Veterinary Officer (1), Technical Assistant (1), Entomologist (1), Technical Officer (IT) (2), and Data Analyst (1).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for PMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form and documents is 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for PMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification differs by post - ranging from MBBS with MD/DNB and postgraduate veterinary or microbiology degrees, to B.Sc./M.Sc. degrees and postgraduate qualifications in IT or statistics. See the post-wise eligibility section above for exact details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for PMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 38 years for the open category and 18 to 43 years for reserved categories, across all 7 posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for PMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for PMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the application form from https://www.pmc.gov.in and submit it, along with self-attested documents, in person at the Health Department office, 3rd Floor, Main Building, Shivaji Nagar, Pune Mahanagarpalika, between 28 August 2026 and 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for PMC Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Salary ranges from Rs. 30,000 per month (Technical Assistant) up to Rs. 1,75,000 per month (Senior Public Health Specialist, for MBBS with MD/DNB candidates). See the vacancy table above for post-wise remuneration.
